definitions.explanation: The bony prominence on each side of the ankle joint. Also refers to the ankle area in general.

examples.japanese: サッカーで{踝|くるぶし}をひねった。
examples.english: I twisted my ankle playing soccer.

examples.japanese: {踝|くるぶし}が{見|み}える{丈|たけ}のパンツが{流行|はや}っている。
examples.english: Pants that show your ankles are in style.

examples.japanese: {踝|くるぶし}まで{水|みず}に{浸|つ}かった。
examples.english: I got wet up to my ankles.

examples.japanese: {踝|くるぶし}の{骨|ほね}が{痛|いた}い。

notes:
KANJI: Often written in hiragana as くるぶし. The kanji {踝|くるぶし} is less common.

ANATOMY:
・{内|うち}くるぶし - inner ankle (medial malleolus)
・{外|そと}くるぶし - outer ankle (lateral malleolus)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
・{踝|くるぶし}をひねる - to twist one's ankle
・{踝|くるぶし}{丈|たけ} - ankle-length
・{踝|くるぶし}ソックス - ankle socks

RELATED BODY PARTS:
・{足首|あしくび} - ankle (more general term for the ankle area)
・{踵|かかと} - heel
・{爪先|つまさき} - toes, toe area
